9:1: This is a disavowal from Allah and His Messenger to the polytheists with whom you made a treaty.
9:2: Travel on the earth for four months and know that you cannot frustrate Allah, and that surely Allah will disgrace the disbelievers.
9:3: And an announcement from Allah and His Messenger to the people on the Day of the Great Hajj: Surely Allah is free from the polytheists, and His Messenger is also free. So if you repent, it is better for you; and if you turn away, know that you cannot frustrate Allah. And give good tidings of a painful punishment to those who disbelieve.
9:4: Except those of the polytheists with whom you made a treaty, and thereafter they diminished nothing from you and did not aid anyone against you; so fulfill their treaty with them until their term. Surely Allah loves those of takwa.
9:5: Then, when the sacred months have passed away, kill the polytheists wherever you find them, capture them, besiege them, and sit in wait for them at every ambush place. But if they repent, establish salah, and give zakat, then leave their way free. Surely Allah is Much-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
9:6: And if any one of the polytheists seeks asylum from you, grant him asylum so that he may hear the word of Allah, then deliver him to his place of safety.
9:7: How can there be a treaty for the polytheists in the sight of Allah and in the sight of His Messenger, except those with whom you made a treaty near al-Masjid al-Haram? So as long as they are upright with you, be upright with them. Surely Allah loves the muttaqin.
9:8: How can it be, when, if they overcome you, they observe concerning you neither kinship tie nor treaty? They please you with their mouths, but their hearts refuse. Most of them are corrupt.
9:9: They sold the verses of Allah for a small price and hindered from His way. Surely, how evil is what they are doing!
9:10: Concerning a believer, they observe neither kinship tie nor a covenant of protection. Those are the very ones who are the transgressors.
9:11: If they repent, establish salah, and give zakat, they are your brothers in faith. We explain the verses for a people who know.
9:12: And if they break their oaths after their treaty and revile your religion, then fight the leaders of disbelief. Surely they have no binding oaths, that they may desist.
9:13: Will you not fight a people who broke their oaths, resolved to expel the Messenger, and attacked you the first time? Do you fear them? But Allah is more worthy of your fear, if you are believers.
9:14: Fight them so that Allah may punish them by your hands, disgrace them, give you victory over them, and heal the chests of a believing people,
9:15: And remove the rage from their hearts. Allah accepts the repentance of whomever He wills. Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise.
9:16: Or did you think that you would be left alone while Allah has not yet made known those among you who strive and who do not take any confidant besides Allah, His Messenger, and the believers? Allah is All-Aware of what you do.
9:17: It is not for the polytheists to maintain the mosques of Allah while witnessing against their own selves with disbelief. Those—their deeds have become worthless, and in the Fire they will abide eternally.
9:18: The mosques of Allah are only maintained by those who believe in Allah and the Last Day, establish salah, give zakat, and fear none except Allah. So it is hoped that those will be among the guided.
9:19: Did you make the providing of water to the pilgrims and the maintaining of al-Masjid al-Haram like the one who believes in Allah and the Last Day and strives in the cause of Allah? They are not equal in the sight of Allah. Allah does not guide the wrongdoing people.
9:20: Those who believed, emigrated, and strove in the cause of Allah with their wealth and their lives are greatest in rank in the sight of Allah.
9:21: Their Rabb gives them good tidings of mercy from Himself, approval, and gardens wherein for them is enduring bliss.
9:22: They will abide therein forever. Surely with Allah is a great reward.
9:23: O you who believe, do not take your fathers and your brothers as allies if they prefer disbelief over faith; whoever of you takes them as allies, then those are the very wrongdoers.
9:24: Say: If your fathers, your sons, your brothers, your spouses, your relatives, the wealth you have acquired, the trade whose stagnation you fear, and the dwellings you are pleased with are more beloved to you than Allah, His Messenger, and striving in His cause, then wait until Allah brings His command; and Allah does not guide the defiantly disobedient people.
9:25: By oath, Allah helped you in many places and on the day of Hunayn, when your great numbers made you marvel, but they availed you nothing, and the earth, despite its vastness, became narrow for you; then you turned your backs, fleeing.
9:26: Then Allah sent down His tranquility upon His Messenger and upon the believers, sent down armies that you did not see, and punished those who disbelieved. And that is the recompense of the disbelievers.
9:27: Then, after that, Allah accepts the repentance of whomever He wills. Allah is Much-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
9:28: O you who believe, the polytheists are only an impurity, so let them not approach al-Masjid al-Haram after this year of theirs; and if you fear poverty, Allah will enrich you from His bounty, if He wills. Surely Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise.
9:29: Fight those who do not believe in Allah and the Last Day, who do not hold unlawful what Allah and His Messenger have made unlawful, and who do not adopt the religion of truth from among those who were given the Scripture, until they give the jizyah with their hands while they are subdued.
9:30: The Jews said Ezra is the son of Allah, and the Christians said the Messiah is the son of Allah. That is their saying with their mouths; they imitate the saying of those who disbelieved before. May Allah fight them; how they are turned away!
9:31: They took their rabbis and their monks as lords besides Allah, and the Messiah, son of Mary; whereas they were not commanded except to worship one God, there is no god except Him. He is exalted far above what they associate as partners.
9:32: They want to extinguish the light of Allah with their mouths, and Allah is the completer of His light, even if the disbelievers dislike it.
9:33: He is the One Who sent His Messenger with guidance and the religion of truth, that He may make it prevail over all religions, even if the polytheists dislike it.
9:34: O you who believe! Surely many of the rabbis and the monks consume the wealth of people in falsehood and hinder from the way of Allah. And those who hoard gold and silver and do not spend them in the cause of Allah, give them the tidings of a painful punishment.
9:35: On that day, it will be heated in the fire of Hell and with it their foreheads, their sides, and their backs will be branded. 'This is what you hoarded for yourselves; so taste what you were hoarding!'
9:36: Undoubtedly, the count of months with Allah is twelve months, in the book of Allah on the day He created the heavens and the earth. Four of them are sacred months. That is the upright religion. So do not wrong yourselves in them, and fight the polytheists completely, as they fight you completely. And know that Allah is with the muttaqin.
9:37: Postponement is only an increase in disbelief. Those who disbelieve are led astray by it; they consider it lawful one year and consider it unlawful one year so that they conform to the number of what Allah made unlawful, and thus make lawful what Allah made unlawful. Their evil deeds were made pleasing to them. Allah does not guide the disbelieving people.
9:38: O you who have believed! What is with you that, when it is said to you "Mobilize in the way of Allah," you cling heavily to the earth? Were you pleased with the worldly life instead of the Hereafter? Yet the provision of the worldly life in the Hereafter is but little.
9:39: If you do not mobilize, He will punish you with a painful punishment and bring in your place another people. You cannot harm Him with anything. Allah is capable of all things.
9:40: If you do not help him, Allah has indeed helped him. When those who disbelieved drove him out, the second of two, when they were in the cave. When he was saying to his companion: Do not grieve, undoubtedly Allah is with us. Thereupon Allah sent down His tranquility upon him and supported him with armies you did not see. And He made the word of those who disbelieved the lowest. And the word of Allah is the highest. Allah is Aziz, Possessor of wisdom.
9:41: Mobilize light and heavy, and strive with your wealth and your lives in the way of Allah. That is better for you, if you know.
9:42: If it had been a near gain and an easy journey, they would have followed you. But the distance seemed far to them. And they will swear by Allah: If we had been able, we would have gone out with you. They destroy their own souls. Allah knows that they are liars.
9:43: Allah has forgiven you; why did you grant them permission until those who spoke the truth became clear to you and you knew the liars?
9:44: Those who believe in Allah and the Last Day do not ask permission of you to strive with their wealth and their lives. Allah is the Knower of those who have taqwa.
9:45: Only those ask permission of you who do not believe in Allah and the Last Day and whose hearts have doubted, so that in their doubt they waver.
9:46: And if they had wanted to go out, they would have made a preparation for it. But Allah disliked their being sent forth, so He held them back, and it was said to them, 'Sit with those who sit.'
9:47: If they had gone out with you, they would not have increased you in anything except corruption and would have hurried about among you, seeking discord.
9:48: And by oath, they had sought discord before as well and had turned matters upside down for you, until the truth came and the command of Allah became manifest, even though they were averse.
9:49: And among them is he who says: Give me permission and do not put me into fitnah. Beware, into fitnah have they fallen! And undoubtedly, Hell has encompassed the disbelievers.
9:50: If a good touches you, it grieves them; and if a misfortune touches you, they say: We took our precaution beforehand.
9:51: Say: "Nothing will strike us except what Allah has written for us. He is our protector. And let the believers rely only upon Allah."
9:52: Say: "Do you await for us anything except one of the two good things? While we await for you that Allah will strike you with a punishment from His own presence or by our hands. So wait; undoubtedly, we too are waiting with you."
9:53: Say: "Spend, whether willingly or unwillingly; it will never be accepted from you. Undoubtedly, you have become a defiantly disobedient people."
9:54: And what prevented their spending from being accepted is that they disbelieved in Allah and His Messenger, and that they come to salah only lazily, and that they spend only unwillingly.
9:55: Let not their wealth and their children amaze you. Allah only intends to punish them with them in the life of this world and that their souls depart while they are disbelievers.
9:56: And they swear by Allah that they are indeed of you, whereas they are not of you, but they are a people who are afraid.
9:57: If they could find a refuge or caves or an entrance, they would turn toward it, rushing.
9:58: And among them are those who criticize you concerning the charities. If they are given from it, they are pleased; and if they are not given from it, they immediately become enraged.
9:59: If only they had been pleased with what Allah and His Messenger gave them and said, 'Allah is sufficient for us; Allah will give us from His bounty, and His Messenger too; undoubtedly, we are desirous of Allah.'
9:60: Charities are only for the poor, for the destitute, for those who work upon it, for those whose hearts are to be softened, for those to be freed from slavery, for the debtors, for those in the way of Allah, and for the traveler, as an obligation from Allah; and Allah is Knower, All-Wise.
9:61: And among them are those who hurt the Prophet and say: "He is an ear." Say: "He is an ear of good for you; he believes in Allah and believes the believers and is a mercy for those who have believed among you." And for those who hurt the Messenger of Allah there is a painful punishment.
9:62: They swear by Allah to you to please you. Whereas Allah and His Messenger, if they are believers, are more worthy for them to please.
9:63: Did they not know that whoever opposes Allah and His Messenger, undoubtedly for him is the fire of Hell, to abide eternally therein? That is the great disgrace.
9:64: The hypocrites beware lest a surah be sent down upon them informing them of what is in their hearts. Say: "Mock on. Undoubtedly, Allah will bring forth what you beware of."
9:65: And by oath, if you ask them, they will surely say, 'We were only conversing and playing.' Say: 'Was it with Allah and His verses and His Messenger that you were mocking?'
9:66: Make no excuse; you have disbelieved after your belief. Even if We pardon a group of you, We will punish a group because they are criminals.
9:67: The hypocrite men and the hypocrite women are of one another. They enjoin evil, forbid good, and tighten their hands. They forgot Allah, so He forgot them. Undoubtedly, the hypocrites, it is they who are the defiantly disobedient.
9:68: Allah has promised the hypocrite men, the hypocrite women, and the disbelievers the fire of Hell, wherein they will abide eternally. It is sufficient for them. Allah has cursed them, and for them is an enduring punishment.
9:69: Like those before you; they were stronger than you in power and more abundant in wealth and children. They enjoyed their share, and you enjoyed your share, just as those before you enjoyed their share. And you plunged as they plunged. Those are the ones whose deeds have come to nothing in this world and the Hereafter. Those are the very ones who are the losers.
9:70: Did there not come to them the news of those before them? The people of Noah, Ad, Thamud, the people of Abraham, the dwellers of Midian, and the overturned cities? Their prophets came to them with clear proofs. Allah was not to wrong them, but they were wronging their own selves.
9:71: The believer men and the believer women are allies of one another; they enjoin good, forbid evil, establish salah, give zakat, and obey Allah and His Messenger. Those, Allah will have mercy upon them. Surely Allah is al-Aziz, al-Hakim.
9:72: Allah has promised the believer men and the believer women gardens beneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide eternally, and pleasant dwellings in the Gardens of Eden (Adn). And pleasure from Allah is greater. That is the great success.
9:73: O Prophet! Strive against the disbelievers and the hypocrites and be harsh against them. Their abode is Hell, and what an evil destination it is.
9:74: They swear by Allah that they did not say it. By oath, they said the word of disbelief and fell into disbelief after their Islam. They attempted that which they could not attain. They were not resentful except that Allah and His Messenger had enriched them from His bounty. If they repent, it will be better for them. If they turn away, Allah will punish them with a painful punishment in this world and the Hereafter. There is for them on the earth neither a protector nor a helper.
9:75: And among them are some who made a covenant with Allah: 'If He gives us of His bounty, we will surely give charity and we will surely be among the righteous,' they said.
9:76: But when He gave them of His bounty, they were stingy with it and turned away; they are ones who turn away.
9:77: Thereupon, because of their breaking the promise they had made to Allah and because they used to lie, He placed hypocrisy in their hearts until the Day they will meet Him.
9:78: Did they not know that Allah surely knows their secret and their whispers, and that Allah is the Knower of the unseen?
9:79: Those who criticize the voluntary contributors among the believers concerning charities and those who find nothing except their effort, and ridicule them—Allah ridicules them, and for them is a painful punishment.
9:80: Ask forgiveness for them or do not ask forgiveness for them. Even if you ask forgiveness for them seventy times, Allah will never forgive them. That is because they disbelieved in Allah and His Messenger.
9:81: Those left behind rejoiced in remaining behind the Messenger of Allah, and they considered it ugly to strive with their wealth and their lives in the cause of Allah. And they said: 'Do not go forth in the heat.' Say: 'The fire of Hell is hotter.' If only they understood.
9:82: So let them laugh a little and weep much as a recompense for what they used to earn.
9:83: If Allah brings you back to a group of them and they ask permission from you to go forth, say: 'You will never go forth with me, and you will never fight any enemy with me. You were pleased to remain behind the first time, so sit with those who sit behind.'
9:84: And never pray over any one of them who died, nor stand by his grave. Surely they disbelieved in Allah and His Messenger, and they died as fasiqun (defiantly disobedient).
9:85: Let not their wealth and their children amaze you. Allah only punished them in the life of this world and desires that their souls depart while they are disbelievers.
9:86: When a surah is sent down—saying, 'Believe in Allah and strive with His Messenger'—those of them with capability ask permission from you and say: 'Leave us, let us be with those who sit behind.'
9:87: They were pleased to be with those who remained behind, and their hearts were sealed, so they do not understand.
9:88: But the Messenger and those who believed with him strived with their wealth and their lives; and those, for them are the good things, and those, they are the ones who attain salvation.
9:89: Allah has prepared for them gardens beneath which rivers flow, they are eternal dwellers therein. That is the great salvation.
9:90: Those with excuses from among the Bedouins came that permission might be given to them, and those who lied to Allah and His Messenger remained behind; a painful punishment will strike them.
9:91: There is no blame upon the weak, nor upon the sick, nor upon those who find nothing to spend, when they are sincere to Allah and His Messenger. There is no way against the doers of good. Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.
9:92: And there is no sin upon those who, when they came to you for you to provide them mounts, when you said, 'I find nothing upon which to carry you,' turned back with their eyes overflowing with tears from grief because they could not find anything to spend.
9:93: The way is only against those who ask permission from you while they are rich. They were pleased to be with those who remained behind, and Allah sealed their hearts, so they do not know.
9:94: They will state excuses to you when you return to them. Say: 'Do not state excuses; we will never believe you. Allah has informed us of your news. Allah and His Messenger will see your deed, then you will be returned to the Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, and He will inform you of what you used to do.'
9:95: When you return to them, they will swear to you by Allah so that you may leave them alone. So turn away from them. For they are impure, and their dwelling place is Hell as a recompense for what they used to earn.
9:96: They swear to you that you may be pleased with them. Even if you are pleased with them, surely Allah is not pleased with the people who are fasiqun (defiantly disobedient).
9:97: The Bedouins are more severe in disbelief and hypocrisy, and more likely not to know the limits of what Allah has sent down to His Messenger.
9:98: And among the Bedouins are some who consider what they spend as a fine and wait for misfortunes to come upon you. Upon them is the circle of evil, and Allah is Hearing, Knowing.
9:99: And of the Arabs are some who believe in Allah and the Last Day and count what they spend as proximities in the sight of Allah and the prayers of the Messenger. Pay attention! Surely it is a proximity for them. Allah will admit them into His mercy. Surely Allah is Most-Forgiving, Most-Merciful (Rahim).
9:100: As for the first forerunners from the Muhajirun and the Ansar and those who followed them in good conduct, Allah was pleased with them, and they were pleased with Him. Allah has prepared for them gardens beneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide forever. That is the great success.
9:101: And among the bedouins around you there are hypocrites, and from the people of Medina as well, who have persisted in hypocrisy. You do not know them; We know them. We will punish them twice, then they will be returned to a great punishment.
9:102: And as for the others, they confessed their sins; they mixed a righteous deed with another evil one. It may be that Allah will accept their repentance. Surely Allah is Most-Forgiving, Most-Merciful.
9:103: Take sadaqah from their wealth so that you may cleanse them and purify them with it, and pray for them; surely your prayers are a tranquility for them, and Allah is All-Hearing, All-Knowing.
9:104: Did they not know that Allah accepts repentance from His servants and receives sadaqahs? And surely Allah is the One Who accepts repentance much, Most-Merciful.
9:105: Say: Work, Allah will see your work, and so will His Messenger and the believers. You will be returned to Allah, the Knower of the unseen and the seen, then He will inform you of what you used to do.
9:106: And others are left to the command of Allah; either He will punish them or He will accept their repentance. Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise.
9:107: And there are those who took a mosque for causing harm, disbelief, causing division among the believers, and preparing an outpost for those who previously fought against Allah and His Messenger. They swear: 'We intended nothing but good.' Allah bears witness that they are certainly liars.
9:108: Never stand there. A mosque founded upon taqwa from the first day is more worthy for you to stand in. In it are men who love to be purified, and Allah loves those who purify themselves.
9:109: Is he who founded his building upon taqwa from Allah and His pleasure better, or he who founded his building on the edge of a cliff about to collapse, so that it tumbled with him into the fire of Hell?
9:110: The building which they built will not cease to remain a doubt in their hearts until their hearts are torn to pieces; and Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise.
9:111: Surely Allah has purchased from the believers their lives and their wealth in return for paradise being theirs. They fight in the cause of Allah, they kill and they are killed. As a true promise in the Torah, the Gospel, and the Quran. And who is more faithful to his promise than Allah? So rejoice in your transaction that you have made; this is the great success.
9:112: Those who repent, those who worship, those who praise, those who travel, those who bow, those who prostrate, those who enjoin what is maruf, those who forbid what is munkar, and those who guard the limits of Allah. And give good tidings to the believers.
9:113: It is not for the Prophet and those who believe to ask forgiveness for the mushriks, even if they be relatives, after it has become clear to them that they are the people of Hell.
9:114: And Abraham's asking forgiveness for his father was only because of a promise he had made to him, but when it became clear to him that he was an enemy to Allah, he dissociated himself from him; surely Abraham was very tender-hearted and gentle-natured.
9:115: Allah is not one to lead a people astray after He has guided them, until He makes clear to them the things they should avoid.
9:116: Surely the dominion of the heavens and the earth belongs to Allah. He gives life and causes death. For you there is no wali nor helper besides Allah.
9:117: By oath, Allah accepted the repentance of the Prophet, the Muhajirun, and the Ansar who followed him in the hour of difficulty when the hearts of a party among them were about to deviate. Then He accepted their repentance. Surely He is very compassionate and very merciful toward them.
9:118: And He also accepted the repentance of the three people who were left behind. Finally, the earth, despite its vastness, became narrow for them, and their souls became narrow for them. They realized that there was no refuge from Allah except in Him. Then Allah accepted their repentance so that they might repent. Surely Allah is the One Who accepts repentance much, Most-Merciful.
9:119: O you who believe, beware of Allah and be with the truthful.
9:120: It was not proper for the people of Medina and the bedouins around them to stay behind Allah's Messenger and to prefer their own lives over his life. For neither thirst, nor fatigue, nor hunger strikes them in the cause of Allah, nor do they set foot on any place that angers the disbelievers, nor do they gain an achievement from the enemy, without a righteous deed being recorded for them in return for these. Surely Allah does not waste the reward of the doers of good.
9:121: They do not make any expenditure, neither small nor large, nor do they cross any valley, without Allah rewarding them with better than what they did.
9:122: It is not right for the believers to set out on an expedition altogether; a group from each division should remain to acquire deep understanding in religion and to warn their people when they return to them.
9:123: O you who believe, fight the disbelievers who are near you, and let them find harshness in you, and know that Allah is with the people of taqwa.
9:124: Whenever a surah is sent down, some of them say: 'Which of you has this increased in faith?' As for those who believe, this has increased their faith and they rejoice.
9:125: As for those in whose hearts is a disease, it has added impurity to their impurity, and they have died as disbelievers.
9:126: Do they not see that they are tested once or twice every year, yet they do not repent and they do not take heed?
9:127: Whenever a surah is sent down, they look at one another: "Does anyone see you?" then they turn away. Allah turned their hearts away, because they are a people who do not understand.
9:128: By oath, there has come to you a messenger from among your own selves. It is heavy upon him that you fall into distress. He is deeply devoted to you, and to the believers he is very compassionate, very merciful.
9:129: If they turn away, say: Allah is sufficient for me; there is no god but Him; in Him I have placed my trust, and He is the Rabb of the great Arsh.
